contents.content:
Whitefield is a bust suburb in Bangalore with vibrant culture, tech parks, and all the kinds of rental stays. You might be a digital nomad looking for an experience or a family searching for a home or an employee on short-term assignment - there's something here for everybody. In this article, we explore the places to look for rental stays in Whitefield.

Key Takeaways

• Whitefield provides rental options in apartments, service apartments, and shared accommodations.
  • Major Areas for rents would be located EPIP zone, ITPL Road, Brookefield,Kundalahalli.
  • You can also find some great places through popular platforms like housing and local real estate agents.
  • Understanding the lease agreement and budgeting are very important when renting in Whitefield.

Types of Rental Stays in Whitefield

    Apartments

    Apartments are one of the common stay types for rent in Whitefield. They are available from 1 BHK up to 3 BHK units and, hence, accommodate varying family compositions as well as varying budgets. Now many apartments incorporate amenities like a swimming pool, a gym, security services, or many more that come along.

    Apartment Type

    Average Rent (per month)

    1 BHK for rent in Whitefield

    ₹15,000 - ₹25,000

    2 BHK for rent in Whitefield

    ₹25,000 - ₹40,000

    3 BHK for rent in Whitefield

    ₹40,000 - ₹60,000

      Service Apartments

      Service apartments are accommodations that offer home comfort with the services of a hotel. They are perfect for business professionals traveling or families who have to be away for some time. They might also include housekeeping and fully equipped kitchens.

      Benefits

      • Flexibility in the duration of stay
      • Fully equipped with kitchen facilities
      • Frequently located around business centers.
      • You can look for options on websites such as Airbnb, which have service apartments specifically for long stays.

Shared Accommodations

Shared accommodations are in high demand among students and young professionals. They provide a cheap way of staying in Whitefield while splitting the costs with roommates. Many shared places are furnished, and utilities are included in the rent.

Top Areas for Rental Stays in Whitefield


EPIP Zone  

The EPIP Zone is located at the eastern edge of Bengaluru, offering excellent residential convenience in proximity to big IT hubs, such as IBM, SAP, and Accenture. The zone is known for its mix of apartments and gated communities, where IT professionals with excellent connectivity along Whitefield Main Road, Outer Ring Road, and ongoing Namma Metro extensions are catered to.

 This EPIP zone has all famous schools, namely Gopalan International and has nearby famous multi-speciality hospital called Aayug Multi Speciality Hospital and many retail vibes at your back. Robust infra and in the neighborhood lies the Metro of Baiyappanahalli and railway of Belandur Road Station are here; additionally, the international Kempegowda Airport is within a radius of 45-kilometres distance from the location.

 EPIP Zone is a perfect place for professionals and families seeking a vibrant yet comfortable living environment, given its booming residential sector, proximity to tech parks, and strong social infrastructure.

ITPL Road  

It's one of the prime rental destinations in Bengaluru. The facility is well linked to major IT parks and good dining and shopping options. Its location, situated 18 kilometres from the heart of the city, is also accessible through the roads SH35, Varthur Road, and HAL Old Airport Road. In terms of convenience, it stands at 6 km from the Whitefield Railway Station, 12 km from the Baiyappanahalli Metro Station, and 37 km from Kempegowda International Airport.

Around its precincts are well-known tech parks:ITPL, Mind Comp Tech Park,Brigade Tech Park, and Kalyani Tech Park. It is 8 km from Marathahalli; 20 km from Koramangala, and Electronic City is a further 29 km. Rentals in the locality are marginally on the higher side on account of it being close to the IT belt.


Brookefield

Brookefield is a residential locality in Bangalore presenting apartments, villas, and independent houses amidst lush and luscious greenery around. Its connectivity with Whitefield and Bangalore's IT hubs makes it as exclusive for professionals as for families. The top schools of this region include Gopalan International and Ryan International and even healthcare options such as Aayug Multi Speciality Hospital ,Brookefield Hospital and MGA Hospital are available for its people. The Brookefield Mall, Inorbit Mall, and Phoenix Market City add a shopping flavor to the place. With serenity, convenience, and comprehensive amenities, Brookfield is the ideal residential destination.


Kundalahalli

Kundalahalli is an advanced residential locality situated in the eastern suburb of Bengaluru, and it is characterized by its calm atmosphere along with its closeness to some major IT hubs like Brigade Tech Gardens and Kalyani Tech Park. This area offers housing units of all kinds, primarily 2 BHK apartments, and also benefits from excellent connectivity via NH-44, State Highway 35, and transportation facilities available at the Hoodi railway station, Kundalahalli metro station, and Munekolala bus stand.

The area is well known for the presence of good educational institutions, including Ryan International School and Vibgyor High, as well as hospitals like Aayug Multi Speciality Hospital and Brookefield Hospital.

Although connectivity directly through the metro is yet to be seen, and traffic congestion is quite common, future infrastructure development, like the metro Phase-2 route and the Kundalahalli Underpass, will be in better connectivity. Kundalahalli is a very coveted residential location that brings the right balance of convenience, comfort, and future growth potential.


Varthur

Varthur is a mixed-use locality on the eastern edge of Bengaluru, consisting of IT parks and residential areas. Large projects from premium builders like Prestige and Brigade call it their home. Varthur Lake is Bangalore's second biggest lake and provides soothing tranquility to residents.

Varthur is a busy location due to its proximity to office spaces; the Varthur Main Road serves as a connecting road between Marathahalli and Sarjapur Road. Commuting is easy via BMTC buses, with Carmelaram and Whitefield railway stations nearby and an upcoming metro station at Hope Farm.

The area houses excellent social infrastructure, including schools such as Whitefield Global School, medical facilities like Columbia Hospital, and malls such as Phoenix Marketcity and Forum Value Mall, besides availing a sound supply of drinking water from the Kauvery River.

Major IT parks of Sigma Softech, ITPB, and RMZ Ecoworld flank Varthur while offices like that of Wipro, Honeywell, PayPal, Cisco, among others can also be seen.

Popular Platforms for Finding Rentals


Online Portals

Several online portals make it easy to find rental properties in Whitefield:

MagicBricks: MagicBricks is a portal which provides the full-fledged searching of various rentals.

Housing.com: Known for a user-friendly interface that lets you filter searches according to your needs.

99 acres:An online real estate portal in India, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with property listings and services like management, legal advice, and financing.

Social Media Groups

Facebook groups dedicated to rentals can be very helpful. You can find local listings or even post your requirements.
Tip: Search for “Whitefield Rentals” on Facebook to join relevant groups.

Tips for Renting in Whitefield

Budgeting for Rent

The budget should be realistic when finding rentals in Whitefield. You should also factor in the maintenance fees, utilities, and internet charges

Sample Budget Breakdown:
Rent: ₹25,000
Maintenance: ₹2,000
Utilities: ₹1,500
Internet: ₹800

Understanding Lease Agreements

Before signing any lease agreement, one should understand all terms clearly. Look out for details regarding the duration of the lease, security deposit requirements, and policies on subletting or pets.

Visiting Properties
Always visit properties before making a decision. This helps one to determine the condition of the apartment and the surroundings. One should always go with a person one trusts in case one cannot decide on matters single-handedly.
